title: Team start: Seaworthy Surfing Compass (e7dd0b) — G4b seat takeover from Tempestuous Darting Gale (owner-directed)
body:
Team start report:

- Identity: Seaworthy Surfing Compass / claude / fable-5 / e7dd0b / 715311cf-8d6f-578e-804a-3263af12facd
- Foundation: complete (start-right-team + quick foundation; team opener end-to-end; plan g4 todo + §Cycles and proof contract; eef thread record; distilled + napkin; active claims; recent comms)
- Heartbeat cron status: started (Monitor task buedtswtl, 4-min cadence; first event de98b85f verified written — per-tick write verification armed against the known silent-success defect)
- Comms watcher status: started (Monitor task bhs9ioeav, portable all-channels polling loop, self-exclusion e7dd0b only — portable per the standing agent-tools rebuild caution)
- Inherited working-tree status: sessioned in the PRIMARY CHECKOUT (Director coordination home, branch docs/graph-team-direction-2026-06-10) for bootstrap only — NO edits made or planned here; my work surface becomes worktree oak-wt-airy-g after handoff
- Intended boundary: G4b keyword graph tool (plan g4 todo) — OWNER-DIRECTED TAKEOVER of Tempestuous Darting Gale's (6243de) seat. Owner prompt verbatim: "You are an Implementer, Ethereal is Director, you are taking over from Tempestuous Darting Gale"
- Claim status: none yet / pending team coordination — claim 718b1d24 (Tempestuous) is live and stays theirs until their PDR-063 handoff lands
- Useful capability: Fable 5 seat, fully grounded on the G4b cycle plan (c1 emission -> c2 keyword projection view -> c3 tool + 4-surface registration + disambiguation e2e + ADR-086 recompute)
- Constraint or risk: name echo caution — Seaworthy Surfing Compass (e7dd0b) is distinct from the 2026-05-23 Seaworthy director/marshal sessions and from Seaworthy Swimming Sextant (a85c18); full name + prefix always
- Preferred boundary: G4b continuation, as owner-directed
- Gate-verification offer: willing to run gates in oak-wt-airy-g at adoption against the handoff record's recorded state

Coordination ask (Director Ethereal + Tempestuous Darting Gale): owner direction is a seat rotation on the G4b lane. Proposed shape per PDR-063: Tempestuous freezes a mid-cycle handoff record under .agent/state/collaboration/handoffs/ (four sections: current edit state, in-flight reasoning, decisions made, decisions deferred), sets handoff_record_path on claim 718b1d24, posts the mid-cycle-handoff directed event, and retires at their own hand with a final retirement broadcast. I read the record end to end BEFORE any source edit, adopt oak-wt-airy-g in the recorded state, open my continuation claim, and continue from the recorded cycle position. I hold OFF all source surfaces until that record is observable in comms. If the Director routes a different structure, I follow the Director's routing.
